item.title: Bulletin updated at 02:55 HKT 30/May/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring mainly fine and hot weather to the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. The anticyclone aloft is expected to weaken slightly midweek this week, there will be more showers over the region. Under the influence of a southwesterly airstream, it will be hot with a few showers over the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week.
